recent_articles.title: Cyber Breach On CBSE Portal Lets Students See Erratic Charges, HDFC Gateway Blamed | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **malicious attack** on the payment system of the **Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)**'s revaluation portal, using the HDFC payment gateway, caused erratic fee displays for approximately 50 students. The breach occurred after a period of non-functionality and authorities are investigating the issue with experts from IIT Madras and IIT Kanpur, alongside the Digital Infrastructure Corporation of India.  To address the vulnerability, four public sector banks have been added as alternate payment gateways. Officials also noted infrastructure changes to improve capacity by shifting the portal to Amazon Web Services.

recent_articles.title: Rare 'intensive' revision in Bihar four months before polls - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** has ordered a special summary revision of electoral rolls in Bihar, marking a departure from its usual practice.  This revision differs from previous intensive revisions by utilizing the 2002-03 electoral roll as a base and incorporating a new pre-printed enumeration form for house-to-house verification. The ECI's decision to conduct this revision ahead of the assembly elections in October 2025 is unusual, as it has rarely ordered full state-wide intensive revisions so far out from the scheduled polls.  This move follows a pattern of the ECI conducting 'intensive' revision in specific areas of states based on various factors like population changes or electoral irregularities.
